note: FNS 724.1 addresses the specific scenario of adding new members prospectively to an otherwise retrospectively budgeted household — mixing prospective income/deductions for the new member with retrospective budget-month income/deductions for existing members. Massachusetts does not use retrospective budgeting. The OLG's certification types are Change Reporting, Simplified Reporting, and Bay State CAP, all of which use prospective budgeting. There is no monthly reporting system in Massachusetts. Since Massachusetts budgets all households prospectively, the mixed-budgeting scenario described in FNS 724.1 cannot arise, and the OLG correctly does not address it. The OLG does cover adding new household members generally (Add a New Person as a SNAP Household Member page), with BEACON procedures and examples, but the retrospective budgeting complication is irrelevant to Massachusetts operations.
